gen-comfortaa-gf-asta-sans: Asta Sans keeps its letterforms tidy and approachable, with tubelike lines that never blot. And Comfortaa above it draws the same rounded, ring-shaped look bigger, so a long page would feel soft and easy going.
gen-comfortaa-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree has light, unpinched round letters and no swelling strokes at all. Comfortaa up top is just as smooth, drawn like neon tubing with a wide-open ring for its c, so a slightly larger heading size makes a nice step down.
gen-comfortaa-gf-barlow: Comfortaa draws every stroke like neon tubing, with a ring-shaped c and spacing stretched out like a spring. And Barlow follows in a contemporary sans-serif, its c tips pulled apart, so the two feel like friendly cousins.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biz-udgothic: Comfortaa draws each glyph in a single-width stroke, with its c opened out like a ring. But BIZ UDGothic, a modern sans-serif, leaves a wide channel into every bowl, so a long page would read crisp and steady.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biz-udpgothic: Friendly Comfortaa is all rounded-nib simplicity, with no swelling at its stroke ends. BIZ UDPGothic, a modern plain sans, does the opposite job, spacing its letters lavishly and leaving a clear channel into each round, which makes it easy on the eye.
gen-comfortaa-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Soft rings, gentle curves. Comfortaa holds its diagonals at the same heft as its stems, while Bpmf Zihi Kai Std, a sans with open counters, adds a faint swell in its curves, which gives the pair a quiet, friendly cadence.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cairo: Hairline-free strokes of constant width give Comfortaa a smooth, neon-tube look, with a ring-like c. Cairo, a professional sans, opens a wide channel into every bowl, so long paragraphs would move along cleanly.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cairo-play: Friendly and geometric, Comfortaa bends constant-width strokes like pipe. Cairo Play, a modern sans with open round letters that stay clear at small sizes, is what makes the pair so readable.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cambay: Comfortaa's gentle monotone of line and its ring-like c make a smooth, friendly heading, a look all its own. Cambay, a plain sans, has rounds that gap like a cracked bangle.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cantarell: Approachable from the first word, Comfortaa rounds out a ring-shaped c and spaces its letters like an uncoiled spring. Cantarell, a plain sans, pulls its c tips apart and gives r, n and m arches that match their stems.
